dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello, I don't have any emergency, but I am making a computer game about your work, and I would like to possibly talk for a moment, can I?
{DO YOU HAVE EMERGENCY?}Sir, do you have an emergency?
No, I do not, I'm sorry, but can we speak?
{NO} No sir, please do not block the line.
{CALL THE OFFICE} Sir, you should contact the Emergency Services Department with your case.
{OK} Well, we can talk for a moment.
Ok, I'm sorry, bye.
Okay, how can I reach it?
{THROUGH A WEBSITE} Please visit the department's website and post a request to meet with the dispatchers.
Ok, can I ask for your name, so I can put it in the request?
{DON'T BLOCK THE LINE} Sorry but you can not. Please do not block the line.
Ok, I'm sorry, thanks and bye.
Ok, but maybe we shall meet after your work so I do not block the line?
{WE CAN TALK NOW} No, it's fine now.
{CALL ME LATER} Yeah that's a better idea. Call me at +48 502 344 222 tomorrow afternoon, OK?
Sure, that sounds great! I will call you tomorrow afternoon then, thank you so much!
{YOU'RE WELCOME} You are welcome!
Ok, then tell me please: what's most challenging about your work?
{TOO MANY ELEMENTS} Hmm, there are just so many reports and teams, its really hard to handle.
{NERVES} Talking with all those people sometimes make me nervous.
{IT'S EASY} Nothing at all, it's quite an easy job
Then, what is most satisfying or entertaining about it?
{HELPING} Helping people, saving lives.
{MANAGEMENT} The management is quite challenging. Air controllers can learn a lot from us, and can tell you!
{I DON'T KNOW} It's just my duty...
Ok, I would like to ask a couple of technical questions, but maybe I should send you an email with those so you can reply in text in your free time?
Sure, however you prefer it. Send them to operator@jutsugames.com.
Ok, Thank You so much! I will write right away!
Hello? Are you there?
Seems I am interrupting something, sorry.

reportElement.texten: A game developer has called with questions concerning the operator's work
Numerous negative articles appeared in social media after intruding the developer's house.
